notes.title: Croissant Release!
notes.notes:
Croissant is now available on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3070330/Croissant/


Drop rates currently on Croissant:
  Common: 90%
  Uncommon: 6%
  Rare: 2.5%
  Ultra Rare: 1%
  Epic: 0.5%

As a reminder, skins are drop either:
- per playtime (every 3 hours)
- by clicking on the croissant (very rare)
- unlockable by code (in in-game inventory)
- by purchasing or exchanging it on Steam
